recipes.title: Italian stuffed zucchini, light
recipes.summary: Tender zucchini boats filled with white beans, rice, tomatoes, basil and parmesan. Extra zucchini and less rice, cheese and oil keep this vegetarian dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prepare the zucchini, onion, garlic and basil in their listed forms.
Scoop the centre from each zucchini half to form a sturdy shell.
Brush the zucchini shells with part of the olive oil.
Bake the zucchini shells until they begin to soften.
Cook the onion in the remaining olive oil until soft and translucent.
Stir the garlic into the onion until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, white beans, white rice, vegetable broth and salt.
Simmer the filling until the white rice is nearly tender and the liquid has reduced.
Fold the parmesan cheese and basil through the filling.
Fill the zucchini shells with the bean and rice mixture.
Bake the stuffed zucchini until tender and lightly browned on top.
Rest the Italian stuffed zucchini before serving.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 3 days and reheat covered until steaming. Freeze the baked zucchini for up to 2 months, though the filling will soften slightly.

recipes.title: Japanese ginger pork with cabbage, light
recipes.summary: Thin pork loin, cabbage and mushrooms glazed with soy, rice wine and ginger. Extra vegetables and less rice and sesame oil keep this Japanese lunch lighter.

steps.instruction: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Cook the white rice until tender and fully steamed.
Prepare the pork loin, green cabbage, onion, mushrooms, ginger, garlic and spring onions in their listed forms.
Stir the soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar, ginger, garlic and sesame oil into a marinade.
Coat the pork loin thoroughly with the marinade.
Marinate the pork loin in the refrigerator.
Heat a wide frying pan until very hot.
Cook the pork loin until browned at the edges and nearly cooked through.
Transfer the pork loin to a clean plate.
Cook the onion and mushrooms until soft and lightly golden.
Add the green cabbage and cook until tender but not limp.
Return the pork loin and marinade to the pan.
Simmer until the pork loin is cooked through and the sauce lightly coats the vegetables.
Finish the Japanese ginger pork with the spring onions.
Serve the ginger pork and green cabbage with the white rice.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the ginger pork and rice separately for up to 3 days. Reheat the pork quickly in a hot pan. Freeze the cooked pork mixture for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Korean soy-braised chicken and potatoes, light
recipes.summary: Tender chicken, potatoes and vegetables braised with soy, rice wine, ginger and sesame. Extra vegetables and less potato and sugar keep this high-protein dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken thigh, potato, carrot, mushrooms, onion, ginger, garlic and spring onions in their listed forms.
Stir the soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, chicken broth and sesame oil into a braising liquid.
Coat the chicken thigh with part of the braising liquid.
Marinate the chicken thigh in the refrigerator.
Heat a large heavy saucepan over medium-high heat.
Brown the chicken thigh on several sides.
Cook the onion until soft and lightly golden.
Add the potato, carrot and mushrooms to the pan.
Pour the remaining braising liquid over the chicken thigh and vegetables.
Bring the Korean braise to a gentle simmer.
Simmer the covered braise until the chicken thigh and potato are tender.
Uncover and simmer until the sauce becomes glossy and lightly thickened.
Toast the sesame seeds in a dry frying pan until fragrant.
Finish the Korean soy-braised chicken with the spring onions and sesame seeds.
Rest the braise before serving.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 3 days and reheat gently until the chicken is steaming. Freeze the braise for up to 2 months; thaw overnight before reheating.

recipes.title: Thai cashew tofu with rice, light
recipes.summary: Golden tofu, cashews and crisp vegetables in a savoury-sweet soy and ginger sauce. Extra broccoli and less rice, oil and nuts keep this vegan Thai dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Rinse the white rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Cook the white rice until tender and fully steamed.
Prepare the tofu, bell pepper, onion, mushrooms, broccoli, spring onions, garlic and ginger in their listed forms.
Stir the soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar, ginger and garlic into a sauce.
Coat the tofu with part of the sauce.
Rest the tofu so it absorbs the seasoning.
Toast the cashew nuts in a dry frying pan until lightly golden.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wide frying pan.
Cook the tofu until golden on several sides.
Transfer the tofu to a clean plate.
Cook the onion and bell pepper until tender and lightly browned.
Add the mushrooms and cook until their moisture evaporates.
Add the broccoli and cook until bright and tender.
Return the tofu and remaining sauce to the pan.
Simmer until the sauce lightly coats the tofu and vegetables.
Finish the Thai cashew tofu with the spring onions and cashew nuts.
Serve the cashew tofu with the white rice.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the tofu mixture and rice separately for up to 3 days. Reheat quickly in a hot pan. Freeze the tofu and vegetables for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: Turkish beef and eggplant casserole, light
recipes.summary: Roasted eggplant and potatoes layered with savoury beef, peppers and tomato, then baked until bubbling. Extra eggplant and less oil keep this Turkish dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Prepare the eggplant, potato, bell pepper, onion and garlic in their listed forms.
Brush the eggplant and potato with part of the olive oil.
Roast the eggplant and potato until tender and lightly browned.
Cook the onion and bell pepper in the remaining olive oil until soft.
Brown the ground beef until no pink remains.
Stir the garlic, paprika, cumin and salt into the beef until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, to the beef mixture.
Simmer the beef sauce until thick and savoury.
Arrange the roasted eggplant and potato in a baking dish.
Spread the beef and tomato sauce evenly over the vegetables.
Bake the Turkish beef and eggplant casserole until bubbling and browned at the edges.
Stir the greek yogurt until smooth.
Rest the casserole so the layers settle.
Serve the casserole with the greek yogurt.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the casserole and yogurt separately for up to 3 days. Reheat covered until steaming. Freeze the casserole without the yogurt for up to 2 months.
